ItemID: 1; Title: 100 Nitrile Exam Gloves 3.5 Mil - Latex & Powder Free, Disposable Non-Sterile Protective Gloves By PlastCare; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Useful disposable gloves for messy workshop cleanup; I would check their suitability before using them with resin.
ItemID: 2; Title: VENLAB Digital Clamp Meter 1000A T-RMS 6000 Counts AC/DC Current Multimeter, Voltage Tester with Auto-ranging Backlight, Measures Voltage Temperature Capacitance Resistance Frequency Continuity NCV; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I like practical diagnostic tools, and this would help with electrical troubleshooting during repairs.
ItemID: 3; Title: 4-40 and 6-32 Machine Screws, Nuts and Washer 280 pcs Pan Head Screws #4-40#6-32 - Screws Nuts and Washers Set - Full Thread Small Screws with Storage Box; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These small imperial sizes complement my metric fastener kits and could help with repair jobs.
ItemID: 4; Title: SOOQOO 50 Pcs KN95 Face Maks for Audlts; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am focused on workshop tools and fasteners right now and have no immediate need for these masks.
ItemID: 5; Title: Touchless Trash Can,3.2 Gallon Waterproof Automatic Smart Bathroom Garbage Can with Lid, Slim Motion Sensor Plastic Narrow Trash Bin for Bedroom, Kitchen, Office,RV White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A small household trash can does not address my current repair or fabrication needs.
ItemID: 6; Title: Dong7Niu Endoscope Camera with Light, 2.4 "IPS HD Screen Borescope Inspection Camera, IP67 Waterproof Home Sewer Camera, Snake Camera with 16.5FT Semi-Rigid Cable; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a triple-lens Teslong inspection camera with the same cable length, so this looks redundant.
ItemID: 7; Title: ELOOGAA 3Pcs Solderless Breadboard 830 Point Solderless Prototype PCB Board Kit for Arduino Proto Shield Distribution Connecting Blocks; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent projects center on mechanical assembly and repairs; I do not currently need circuit prototyping supplies.
ItemID: 8; Title: Decibel Meter, CURCONSA SPL Meter, Portable Sound Level Meter, 30dB to 130dB, LCD Display, can be Used in Homes, Factories and Streets(Blue); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I enjoy measurement tools, but I have no specific sound-measurement task to justify choosing this now.
ItemID: 9; Title: 100 Pc 6"x.045"x7/8" Cut-Off Wheels Lincoln Abrasives Metal & Stainless Steel; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My previous cutting wheels were 5-inch; I would not choose a bulk pack of 6-inch wheels without confirming tool compatibility.
ItemID: 10; Title: JROUTH 1500pcs Screws Assortment Hex Socket Flat Head Black Screws Nuts and Bolts, M2 M3 M4 M5 10.9 Grade Alloy Steel Hex Flat Head Cap Bolts Nuts Washers Assortment Kit with Hex Wrenches; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The flat heads offer a useful flush-mount option alongside my existing metric socket-head fasteners.
